title: Avatar TY Tomato (Avatar TY F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Avatar TY tomato is an F1 hybrid tomato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Avatar TY tomato is an F1 hybrid tomato variety, also sold or known as Avatar TY F1 or Avatar F1. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: Young tomato plants on silver plastic mulch beds with bamboo stakes in San Ildefonso, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Avatar TY tomato is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Avatar TY F1 or Avatar F1, this is the same tomato. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [tomato variety finder](/crop-varieties/tomato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [fertilizer for tomatoes, stage by stage](/blog/fertilizer-for-tomatoes).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: first harvest 60 to 65 days after transplanting (seller sheet). No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 60 to 65 days after transplanting (seller sheet).
**Fruit:** High round with thick flesh, 70 to 90 g (about 12 to 14 fruits per kilo by a grower's count), green turning red orange then red.
**Season:** Dry season on the seller sheet, Pampanga growers also plant it as soon as the rains start.
**Where:** Midland to highland on the seller sheet, also grown in lowland Pampanga and Quezon.
Intermediate resistance to tomato yellow leaf curl virus (TYLCV).
Resists cracking, green picked fruit kept about a month at room temperature and still reddened, per a Pampanga grower.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: Agriculture Monthly found Pampanga agri supply stores and farmers favouring it for off season planting, a Quezon grower tried it in 2025. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual tomato on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Avatar TY tomato

Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Avatar TY F1 the same as Avatar TY?
items.a: Yes. Avatar TY F1 is another name for Avatar TY. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Avatar TY?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
